video_title: How Our Suits Are Designed and Made | Shiv Saree Emporium
video_intro: Watch the video to see how our suits move from design planning and fabric selection through embroidery, stitching and finishing.
video_description: See how suits are designed and made at Shiv Saree Emporium in Chandni Chowk.
supporting_text:
Our team works through design planning, fabric selection, embroidery, stitching and finishing to create ladies suits for different occasions. Each stage contributes to the final look, comfort and presentation.

The process combines design ideas with careful fabric selection and detailed workmanship. Finished pieces are checked before they are prepared for buyers.
transcript: In this video, you will see how our suits are designed and manufactured. The process includes design and pattern planning, fabric selection, embroidery and detailing, stitching and finishing, followed by quality checking and packing.
